text.en: Front border and upper surface of the outer third of the clavicle.
text.zh: 锁骨外侧三分之一的前缘和上面。

text.en: Deltoid tuberosity, on the outer side of the middle of the humerus.
text.zh: 三角肌粗隆，位于肱骨中段外侧。

direction.en: Down and back over the front of the shoulder to the side of the arm.
direction.zh: 经肩前方向后下斜行到上臂外侧。

feel.en: Touch the front of your shoulder, just outside the collarbone, and lift your arm straight forward: the rounded muscle there hardens.
feel.zh: 摸肩膀前面、锁骨外侧那一块，然后把手臂向正前方抬起：那块圆鼓鼓的肌肉会变硬。

mistakes.en: Letting a steep incline turn a chest press into a shoulder press.
mistakes.zh: 凳子太陡，把推胸做成了推肩。

mistakes.en: Lowering the bar or dumbbells so far that the front of the shoulder is strained.
mistakes.zh: 杠铃或哑铃放得太低，肩前部被拉得难受。

summary.en: Raises the arm forward; helps in every press.
summary.zh: 把手臂向前抬；各种推的动作都有它。

detail.en:
The front part of the deltoid, from the front edge and upper surface of the outer third of the collarbone to the deltoid tuberosity halfway down the humerus [M1] [M31]. It is the main muscle that raises the arm forward (flexion) and it helps turn the arm inward; in every press it works with the clavicular part of pectoralis major [M31] [M5].

Research shows: in 30 trained adults bench-pressing at five bench angles, front-deltoid EMG rose as the bench got steeper and was highest at 60°, while upper-chest EMG peaked at 30° [M8]. Higher EMG is not by itself proof of more growth [M9].
detail.zh:
三角肌的前部，从锁骨外侧三分之一的前缘和上面，止于肱骨中段外侧的三角肌粗隆 [M1] [M31]。它是把手臂向前抬（肩屈）的主要肌肉，也帮上臂内旋；每一种推的动作里，它都和胸大肌锁骨部一起出力 [M31] [M5]。

研究显示：30 名有训练经验的成年人在五种凳子角度上卧推，凳子越陡，三角肌前部的肌电越高，在 60° 时最高；上胸的肌电则在 30° 时最高 [M8]。肌电高本身不等于长得更多 [M9]。

text.en: Lateral third of the clavicle, lateral acromion, and lower lip of the crest of the scapular spine.
text.zh: 锁骨外侧三分之一、肩峰外侧缘及肩胛冈嵴下唇。

text.en: Deltoid tuberosity on the lateral surface of the humeral shaft.
text.zh: 肱骨干外侧面的三角肌粗隆。

direction.en: Front and back bundles slope down towards the arm; middle bundles attach obliquely to internal tendon sheets.
direction.zh: 前、后部肌束斜向下汇聚到上臂；中部肌束斜接于肌内腱性隔。

feel.en: Rest one hand on the rounded cap of your other shoulder and lift that arm forward, then out to the side, then back: a different part hardens under your hand each time.
feel.zh: 一只手轻放在另一侧圆鼓鼓的肩头，那只手臂依次向前抬、向侧面抬、向后抬：每一次，手下变硬的是不同的部位。

mistakes.en: Treating front, side and rear delts as three separate muscles: they share one attachment on the humerus.
mistakes.zh: 把前束、中束、后束当成三块独立的肌肉：它们共用肱骨上的同一个止点。

mistakes.en: Only pressing: presses lift the arm forward, so pulling it back needs rows as well.
mistakes.zh: 只练推举：推举主要是向前上抬臂，向后拉还要靠划船来练。

summary.en: Lifts the arm forward, sideways and back.
summary.zh: 把手臂向前、向侧面、向后抬。

detail.en:
The rounded cap of the shoulder is one muscle in three parts. The clavicular (front) part starts on the outer collarbone, the acromial (middle) part on the acromion and the spinal (rear) part on the scapular spine; all three end on the deltoid tuberosity of the humerus [M48] [M2]. Roughly, the front part lifts the arm forward, the middle part sideways and the rear part pulls it back, but their jobs overlap [M48] [M2].

Under the deltoid, supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis form the rotator cuff. While the deltoid lifts, the cuff keeps the head of the humerus centred in its shallow socket. Teres major lies nearby but is not part of the cuff [M48] [M86].
detail.zh:
肩头那块圆鼓鼓的肌肉是一块肌肉，分三部：锁骨部（前束）起于锁骨外侧，肩峰部（中束）起于肩峰，肩胛冈部（后束）起于肩胛冈；三部都止于肱骨的三角肌粗隆 [M48] [M2]。粗略地说，前部把手臂向前抬，中部向侧面抬，后部向后拉，但它们的工作有重叠 [M48] [M2]。

三角肌下面，冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌组成肩袖。三角肌抬臂的时候，肩袖把肱骨头稳在浅浅的关节盂中央。大圆肌就在旁边，但不属于肩袖 [M48] [M86]。

text.en: Lateral margin and superior surface of the acromion of the scapula.
text.zh: 肩胛骨肩峰的外侧缘和上面。

text.en: Deltoid tuberosity on the lateral surface of the humeral shaft.
text.zh: 肱骨干外侧面的三角肌粗隆。

direction.en: Short oblique bundles meet several internal tendon sheets, descending from the acromion to the lateral humerus.
direction.zh: 短肌束斜接于多片肌内腱性隔，整体从肩峰向下到肱骨外侧。

feel.en: Put your fingertips just below the bony point of the shoulder and lift the arm out to the side: the outer part of the shoulder cap hardens. A pinch inside the joint is not the feeling you want.
feel.zh: 指尖放在肩头骨性突起的正下方，手臂向侧面抬起：肩头外侧会变硬。关节里面有夹痛感就不对了。

mistakes.en: Swinging the hips to throw the dumbbells up.
mistakes.zh: 靠髋部甩动把哑铃抛上去。

mistakes.en: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears as the arms rise.
mistakes.zh: 抬臂时耸肩，肩膀往耳朵方向提。

summary.en: Lifts the arm out to the side.

detail.en:
The middle part starts on the outer edge and upper surface of the acromion. Inside it, several tendon sheets run down the muscle and short fibres join them at an angle, an arrangement called multipennate [M48]. It is the main muscle that lifts the arm sideways (abduction) [M2].

A side raise is never the deltoid alone: supraspinatus helps lift and steady the joint, and as the arm rises the trapezius and serratus anterior turn the shoulder blade upward [M48] [M2].
detail.zh:
中部起于肩峰的外侧缘和上面。肌肉内部有几片纵行的腱膜，短短的肌纤维斜着接在它们上面，叫多羽状排列 [M48]。它是把手臂向侧面抬起（外展）的主要肌肉 [M2]。

侧平举从来不只是三角肌在工作：冈上肌帮着抬臂并稳住关节；手臂抬高时，斜方肌和前锯肌还把肩胛骨向上旋转 [M48] [M2]。

muscles.zAnatomy: Scapular spinal part of deltoid muscle

text.en: Lower lip of the posterior border of the spine of the scapula.
text.zh: 肩胛冈后缘的下唇。

text.en: Deltoid tuberosity on the lateral surface of the humeral shaft.
text.zh: 肱骨干外侧面的三角肌粗隆。

direction.en: Down and forward from the scapular spine across the back of the shoulder to the lateral humerus.
direction.zh: 从肩胛冈经肩后方向前下斜行到肱骨外侧。

feel.en: Touch the back of your shoulder cap and draw the upper arm backward: the muscle under your fingers tightens.
feel.zh: 手放在肩头后面，把上臂往后带：手指下面的肌肉会绷紧。

mistakes.en: Only squeezing the shoulder blades together: the upper arm has to move back too.
mistakes.zh: 只顾夹肩胛骨：上臂也要往后走。

mistakes.en: Yanking the elbows far behind the body with momentum.
mistakes.zh: 借惯性把手肘猛拉到身体后面很远。

summary.en: Pulls the arm back and opens it outward.
summary.zh: 把手臂向后拉，并向外打开。

detail.en:
The rear part starts on the lower lip of the scapular spine and runs down and forward to the deltoid tuberosity [M48]. It pulls the arm backward (extension), opens a raised arm out and back (horizontal abduction) and helps turn the arm outward [M48] [M2] [M31].

Rows, face pulls and straight-arm pulldowns all use it, together with the back muscles that move the shoulder blade.
detail.zh:
后部起于肩胛冈的下唇，向前下方走到三角肌粗隆 [M48]。它把手臂往后拉（肩伸），把抬起的手臂向外、向后打开（水平外展），还帮上臂外旋 [M48] [M2] [M31]。

划船、面拉和直臂下拉都会用到它，移动肩胛骨的背部肌肉也同时在工作。

text.en: Medial two-thirds of the supraspinous fossa of the scapula and the fascia covering it.
text.zh: 肩胛骨冈上窝内侧三分之二及其表面的筋膜。

text.en: Superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus; the tendon blends with the shoulder-joint capsule.
text.zh: 肱骨大结节上面；止腱与肩关节囊相融合。

direction.en: Laterally from above the scapular spine, narrowing into a tendon beneath the acromion.
direction.zh: 从肩胛冈上方向外汇聚，形成从肩峰下通过的肌腱。

feel.en: It is buried under trapezius and the deltoid. Find the bony ridge across the back of your shoulder blade, the scapular spine: supraspinatus fills the hollow just above it.
feel.zh: 它被斜方肌和三角肌盖住。先摸到肩胛骨背面那条横着的骨嵴，也就是肩胛冈，冈上肌就填在它上方的窝里。

mistakes.en: Saying it only works for the first few degrees of a raise.
mistakes.zh: 说它只在抬臂最开始的几度里工作。

mistakes.en: Pushing on through a pinch at the top of a raise.
mistakes.zh: 抬臂到顶时有夹痛，还硬顶着往上抬。

summary.en: Helps lift the arm; holds the humeral head in place.
summary.zh: 协助抬臂，并把肱骨头稳在关节盂里。

detail.en:
It fills the hollow above the scapular spine (supraspinous fossa) and narrows into a tendon that runs under the acromion to the top facet of the greater tubercle; the tendon blends with the joint capsule [M48]. It helps the deltoid lift the arm sideways and, as part of the rotator cuff, holds the head of the humerus in its socket [M2] [M86].

It is often said to start the lift on its own and then hand over to the deltoid. Anatomy texts simply describe it as helping the deltoid raise the arm; there is no hand-over point [M48] [M2].
detail.zh:
它填在肩胛冈上方的窝（冈上窝）里，向外收成一条腱，从肩峰下面穿过，止于肱骨大结节最上面的小面；腱和关节囊融合在一起 [M48]。它帮三角肌把手臂向侧面抬起，作为肩袖的一员，还把肱骨头稳在关节盂里 [M2] [M86]。

常听人说它只负责抬臂的开头，然后交给三角肌。解剖书只说它协助三角肌抬起手臂，并没有这样一个交接点 [M48] [M2]。

injury.en: Its tendon, which runs under the acromion, is the cuff tendon most often torn. A tear can follow a fall or a sudden heavy pull, or develop slowly with wear; some cause pain and weakness, others few symptoms [M83]. This is general information, not medical advice; for pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
injury.zh: 它的腱从肩峰下面通过，是肩袖里最常撕裂的肌腱。撕裂可能发生在跌倒或突然发力拉重物之后，也可能随磨损慢慢出现；有的会疼、会无力，有的几乎没有症状 [M83]。本页是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Medial two-thirds of the infraspinous fossa of the scapula and the fascia covering it.
text.zh: 肩胛骨冈下窝内侧三分之二及其表面的筋膜。

text.en: Middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus; tendon fibres join the shoulder-joint capsule.
text.zh: 肱骨大结节中面；止腱纤维与肩关节囊相连。

direction.en: Fans out below the scapular spine and converges laterally towards the back of the humeral head.
direction.zh: 在肩胛冈下方呈扇形展开，向外汇聚到肱骨头后方。

feel.en: It lies on the flat of the shoulder blade below the spine, partly under the rear deltoid. Keep your elbow at your side, bent to a right angle, and turn the forearm outward: the muscle on the blade firms up.
feel.zh: 它在肩胛冈下面、肩胛骨平坦的那一片上，外侧一部分被三角肌后部盖住。手肘贴住身体侧面、弯成直角，前臂向外转：肩胛骨上那片肌肉会变硬。

mistakes.en: Twisting the trunk instead of turning the upper arm.
mistakes.zh: 用转身代替上臂外旋。

mistakes.en: Letting the elbow drift away from the side to move a heavier load.
mistakes.zh: 为了拉更重的重量，让手肘离开身体侧面。

summary.en: Turns the arm outward and steadies its head.
summary.zh: 使上臂外旋，并稳住肱骨头。

detail.en:
A thick triangle that fills the hollow below the scapular spine (infraspinous fossa) and converges on the middle facet of the greater tubercle [M48]. It is the main muscle that turns the arm outward (external rotation) [M48] [M2]. With the elbow bent, the forearm swings like a pointer and shows how far the upper arm has turned.

Research shows: in 10 healthy people with fine-wire electrodes in the muscles, side-lying external rotation gave the highest infraspinatus activity of the seven exercises tested [M53]. Higher EMG is not by itself proof of more growth [M9].
detail.zh:
一块厚厚的三角形肌肉，填满肩胛冈下方的窝（冈下窝），汇聚到肱骨大结节中间的小面 [M48]。它是让上臂外旋的主要肌肉 [M48] [M2]。手肘弯曲时，前臂像一根指针，能看出上臂转了多少。

研究显示：10 名健康人在肌肉里插入细线电极，测试的七个动作中，侧卧外旋时冈下肌的肌电最高 [M53]。肌电高本身不等于长得更多 [M9]。

text.en: Upper two-thirds of the posterior surface along the lateral border of the scapula, with adjoining fascial septa.
text.zh: 肩胛骨外侧缘后面上三分之二及邻近的肌间隔。

text.en: Inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus; some lower fibres attach just below it, and the tendon joins the capsule.
text.zh: 肱骨大结节下面；部分下方纤维止于其下方，止腱与关节囊相连。

direction.en: Up and laterally along the outer scapula towards the back of the humeral head.
direction.zh: 沿肩胛骨外侧缘向外上方走，到肱骨头后方。

feel.en: A narrow strip along the outer edge of the shoulder blade, between infraspinatus and teres major. Turn the bent arm outward and it works with infraspinatus; do not dig into the armpit to find it.
feel.zh: 沿肩胛骨外侧缘的一条窄肌，夹在冈下肌和大圆肌之间。屈肘把前臂向外转，它会和冈下肌一起用力；不要往腋窝里挖着找它。

mistakes.en: Confusing it with teres major: one turns the arm outward, the other inward.
mistakes.zh: 把它和大圆肌搞混：一个让上臂外旋，一个让它内旋。

mistakes.en: Forcing the forearm out past a comfortable end point.
mistakes.zh: 把前臂硬往外转，超过舒服的范围。

summary.en: Turns the arm outward; a rotator-cuff muscle.
summary.zh: 使上臂外旋，是肩袖的一员。

detail.en:
It runs from the upper two-thirds of the outer border of the shoulder blade to the lowest facet of the greater tubercle [M48]. It turns the arm outward with infraspinatus and, as part of the rotator cuff, helps hold the head of the humerus in place [M48] [M86].

Despite the name, it pulls the opposite way to teres major: teres minor turns the arm outward, teres major turns it inward [M48].
detail.zh:
它从肩胛骨外侧缘的上三分之二，止于肱骨大结节最下面的小面 [M48]。它和冈下肌一起让上臂外旋，作为肩袖的一员，还帮着把肱骨头稳在关节盂里 [M48] [M86]。

名字和大圆肌只差一个字，拉的方向却相反：小圆肌让上臂外旋，大圆肌让它内旋 [M48]。

text.en: Medial two-thirds of the subscapular fossa, the lower part of the groove along the lateral border, and tendinous sheets attached to scapular ridges.
text.zh: 肩胛下窝内侧三分之二、外侧缘沟的下部，以及附于骨嵴的腱性隔。

text.en: Lesser tubercle of the humerus and the anterior shoulder-joint capsule.
text.zh: 肱骨小结节及肩关节囊前部。

direction.en: Oblique bundles meet tendon sheets on the front of the scapula and converge laterally to the lesser tubercle.
direction.zh: 肩胛骨前面的多束斜行肌束接于腱性隔，向外汇聚到肱骨小结节。

feel.en: It lies between the shoulder blade and the ribs, so you cannot feel it. With the elbow at your side, turn the forearm in toward your belly against light resistance: the effort deep in the front of the shoulder includes it.
feel.zh: 它夹在肩胛骨和肋骨之间，摸不到。手肘贴在身体侧面，对抗轻阻力把前臂往肚子方向转：肩前部深处的用力感里有它。

mistakes.en: Thinking it lies below the shoulder blade: it covers the side facing the ribs.
mistakes.zh: 以为它长在肩胛骨下方：它铺在肩胛骨贴肋骨的那一面。

mistakes.en: Swinging the elbow across the body instead of turning the upper arm.
mistakes.zh: 让手肘横着扫过身体，代替上臂内旋。

summary.en: Turns the arm inward; the front of the cuff.
summary.zh: 使上臂内旋，是肩袖前方的那一块。

detail.en:
The cuff muscle on the front of the shoulder blade covers the surface that faces the ribs (subscapular fossa) and ends on the lesser tubercle at the front of the humerus; the other three cuff tendons end on the greater tubercle [M48]. It turns the arm inward (internal rotation) and holds the head of the humerus from the front [M48] [M2].

“Sub” here means in front of the blade: the muscle is sandwiched between the shoulder blade and the rib cage, not below the bone.
detail.zh:
肩袖里位于前面的那块肌肉，铺满肩胛骨贴着肋骨的那一面（肩胛下窝），止于肱骨前面的小结节；另外三块肩袖肌都止于大结节 [M48]。它让上臂内旋，并从前方把肱骨头稳住 [M48] [M2]。

名字里的“下”，指的是在肩胛骨的前面、夹在肩胛骨和胸廓之间，不是在骨头下方。

text.en: Posterior surface of the inferior angle of the scapula and the lower part of its lateral border, with adjoining fascial septa.
text.zh: 肩胛骨下角后面及外侧缘下部，还有邻近的肌间隔。

text.en: Crest of the lesser tubercle of the humerus, the medial lip of the intertubercular groove.
text.zh: 肱骨小结节嵴，即结节间沟内侧唇。

direction.en: Up and laterally from the lower outer scapula to the front-medial side of the proximal humerus.
direction.zh: 从肩胛骨外下方向外上方走，到肱骨上端前内侧。

feel.en: With latissimus dorsi it forms the back fold of the armpit. Raise an arm and pull it down against your other hand: the fold firms up.
feel.zh: 它和背阔肌一起构成腋窝后壁。举起一只手臂，用另一只手挡着往下拉：腋窝后面那道肉会变硬。

mistakes.en: Counting it as a fifth rotator-cuff muscle.
mistakes.zh: 把它当成第五块肩袖肌。

mistakes.en: Bending the elbows in a straight-arm pulldown, so it becomes a triceps pushdown.
mistakes.zh: 直臂下拉时屈肘，做成了肱三头肌下压。

summary.en: Pulls a raised arm down; helps turn it inward.
summary.zh: 把抬起的手臂拉下来，并协助内旋。

detail.en:
It runs from the back of the lower corner of the shoulder blade to the inner lip of the groove on the front of the humerus, next to the latissimus tendon [M48]. It helps latissimus pull a raised arm down and back and turn it inward [M48] [M2]; in pull-ups and pulldowns the two work together.

Teres major is not part of the rotator cuff. Its tendon ends lower down on the humerus, not on the tubercles that the cuff tendons grip [M48] [M86].
detail.zh:
它从肩胛骨下角的背面，止于肱骨前面结节间沟的内侧唇，紧挨着背阔肌的腱 [M48]。它帮背阔肌把抬起的手臂向下、向后拉，并让上臂内旋 [M48] [M2]；做引体向上和高位下拉时，两者一起工作。

大圆肌不属于肩袖。它的腱止在肱骨上较低的地方，不在肩袖肌腱包住的那两个结节上 [M48] [M86]。

text.en: Medial superior nuchal line and external occipital protuberance, with the nuchal ligament.
text.zh: 上项线内侧部、枕外隆凸及项韧带。

text.en: Posterior border of the lateral third of the clavicle.
text.zh: 锁骨外侧三分之一的后缘。

direction.en: Down and laterally from the back of the head and neck to the outer clavicle.
direction.zh: 从后脑和颈后向外下方走，到锁骨外侧。

feel.en: Rest your fingers on the slope between neck and shoulder and shrug gently: the muscle firms up under them.
feel.zh: 手指放在脖子到肩膀的斜坡上，轻轻耸肩：手指下面的肌肉会变硬。

mistakes.en: Trying to keep it completely relaxed while lifting overhead.
mistakes.zh: 举过头顶时硬要它完全放松。

mistakes.en: Starting a lateral raise with a shrug instead of moving the arm.
mistakes.zh: 侧平举一开始先耸肩，而不是先抬手臂。

summary.en: Lifts the shoulder girdle; helps turn the blade up.
summary.zh: 上提肩带，并帮肩胛骨向上旋转。

detail.en:
The upper fibres run from the back of the skull (the inner third of the superior nuchal line and the external occipital protuberance) and the neck ligament down and outward to the back of the outer third of the collarbone [M48]. They lift the shoulder girdle, as in a shrug, and work with the lower trapezius and serratus anterior to turn the shoulder blade upward when the arm goes overhead [M48] [M2].

So some lift of the shoulders during an overhead press is normal. What to avoid is hunching the shoulders up to the ears before the arm moves.
detail.zh:
上部纤维从后脑（上项线内侧三分之一和枕外隆凸）和项韧带，向外下方走到锁骨外侧三分之一的后缘 [M48]。它们上提肩带，就像耸肩；手臂举过头顶时，还和斜方肌升部、前锯肌一起把肩胛骨向上旋转 [M48] [M2]。

所以推举时肩膀稍微抬起是正常的。要避免的是手臂还没动，就先把肩膀耸到耳朵边。

text.en: Lower thoracic spinous processes, thoracolumbar fascia over the lumbar and sacral region, posterior iliac crest, and lower ribs. A slip may also arise from the inferior scapular angle.
text.zh: 下位胸椎棘突、覆盖腰骶区的胸腰筋膜、髂嵴后部及下位肋骨；还可有肌束起于肩胛骨下角。

text.en: Floor of the intertubercular groove on the proximal humerus.
text.zh: 肱骨上端结节间沟底。

direction.en: Broad lower-back fibres sweep upward and outward into a tendon at the arm.
direction.zh: 广阔的下背部纤维向外上方汇聚，形成连到上臂的肌腱。

feel.en: Raise one arm and pull it down to your side against the other hand: the broad band along the side of your back and the back fold of the armpit harden.
feel.zh: 举起一只手臂，用另一只手挡着把它往身体侧面拉下来：背部外侧那一大片和腋窝后壁都会变硬。

mistakes.en: Thinking pull-ups mainly train the arms: latissimus moves the shoulder.
mistakes.zh: 以为引体向上主要练手臂：真正拉动肩关节的是背阔肌。

mistakes.en: Swinging or leaning far back to finish a pulldown.
mistakes.zh: 做高位下拉时靠身体大幅后仰、摆动来拉完。

summary.en: Pulls the arm down and back; turns it inward.
summary.zh: 把手臂向下、向后拉，并使它内旋。

detail.en:
The widest muscle of the back. It starts on the spines of the lower six thoracic vertebrae, the thoracolumbar fascia (and through it the lumbar and sacral spines), the back of the iliac crest and the lowest three or four ribs, often with a slip from the lower corner of the shoulder blade. Its fibres converge, twist and end in a flat tendon in the floor of the groove on the front of the humerus [M48] [M2].

It pulls the arm down and back (extension and adduction) and turns it inward [M48] [M2]. That makes it, not the arms, the prime mover in a pull-up or lat pulldown: it does the main work at the shoulder, while the biceps and other elbow flexors bend the elbow alongside it [M51].
detail.zh:
背部最宽的一块肌肉。它起于下面六个胸椎的棘突、胸腰筋膜（借它连到腰椎和骶骨的棘突）、髂嵴后部和最下面三四根肋骨，常常还有一束来自肩胛骨下角。纤维向外上方汇聚、扭转，以一条扁腱止于肱骨前面结节间沟的沟底 [M48] [M2]。

它把手臂向下、向后拉（肩伸和内收），并让上臂内旋 [M48] [M2]。所以引体向上和高位下拉的主动肌是它，而不是手臂：主要的力气由它在肩关节上出，肱二头肌等屈肘肌在旁边负责弯肘 [M51]。

text.en: Spinous processes and supraspinous ligaments of the upper thoracic vertebrae, usually T2–T5.
text.zh: 上位胸椎棘突及棘上韧带，通常为第 2–5 胸椎。

text.en: Medial border of the scapula below the root of the scapular spine.
text.zh: 肩胛冈根部以下的肩胛骨内侧缘。

direction.en: Down and outward from the upper spine to the medial scapular border.
direction.zh: 从上位脊柱向外下方走到肩胛骨内侧缘。

feel.en: It lies under trapezius between the spine and the shoulder blade. Squeeze the blades together: the area between them firms up, but you cannot pick out the rhomboid by touch.
feel.zh: 它在斜方肌下面，位于脊柱和肩胛骨之间。把两块肩胛骨往中间夹，两者之间会绷紧，但用手摸分不出哪一块是菱形肌。

mistakes.en: Rowing only with the arms, so the shoulder blades never move.
mistakes.zh: 划船只动手臂，肩胛骨一直不动。

mistakes.en: Pushing the chest and ribs forward to fake a squeeze.
mistakes.zh: 靠挺胸、把肋骨往前顶，假装夹紧了肩胛骨。

summary.en: Draws the shoulder blade toward the spine.

detail.en:
A flat four-sided sheet from the spines of T2–T5 to the inner border of the shoulder blade, from the root of the spine down to the lower corner [M48] [M2]. It pulls the blade toward the spine (retraction), helps turn its socket downward and holds the inner border flat against the chest wall [M48] [M2].

In every row it draws the shoulder blades back while latissimus dorsi and the rear deltoid move the upper arms.
detail.zh:
一片扁平的四边形肌肉，从第 2–5 胸椎的棘突，走到肩胛骨内侧缘、从肩胛冈根部一直到下角 [M48] [M2]。它把肩胛骨拉向脊柱（后缩），帮关节盂向下转，并把肩胛骨内侧缘贴在胸壁上 [M48] [M2]。

每一种划船里，它负责把肩胛骨往回收，背阔肌和三角肌后部则负责拉动上臂。

text.en: Spinous processes of C7 and the upper thoracic vertebrae, with the lower end of the nuchal ligament.
text.zh: 第 7 颈椎和上位胸椎的棘突，以及项韧带下端。

text.en: Medial acromial margin and upper lip of the scapular spine.
text.zh: 肩峰内侧缘及肩胛冈上唇。

direction.en: Across from the spine to the acromion and scapular spine.
direction.zh: 从脊柱横向走到肩峰与肩胛冈。

feel.en: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and feel across the top of your back between them; the rhomboids work underneath.
feel.zh: 把两块肩胛骨往中间夹，摸摸它们之间、上背横着的那一片；菱形肌在它下面一起用力。

mistakes.en: Shrugging up instead of drawing the blades straight back.
mistakes.zh: 往上耸肩，而不是把肩胛骨平平地往后收。

mistakes.en: Arching the low back so that the shoulders only look as if they went back.
mistakes.zh: 用腰往后弓，看起来像是肩膀收回去了。

summary.en: Pulls the shoulder blades back toward the spine.
summary.zh: 把肩胛骨向后拉向脊柱。

detail.en:
The middle fibres run straight across from the spines of C7 and the upper thoracic vertebrae to the inner edge of the acromion and the upper lip of the scapular spine [M48] [M2]. Pulling across, they draw the shoulder blade toward the spine (retraction), together with the rhomboids.

Rows, inverted rows and face pulls all finish with this squeeze.
detail.zh:
中部纤维从第 7 颈椎和上位胸椎的棘突横着走，止于肩峰内侧缘和肩胛冈的上唇 [M48] [M2]。它们横向拉，和菱形肌一起把肩胛骨拉向脊柱（后缩）。

划船、反向划船和面拉的最后，都是这一下“夹”。
